title: Refactor local variable in Go FormatCents helper
description: Internal comment and local variable rename in internal/billing/formatter.go without changing exported signature or output.
diff:
diff --git a/internal/billing/formatter.go b/internal/billing/formatter.go
index 1111111..2222222 100644
--- a/internal/billing/formatter.go
+++ b/internal/billing/formatter.go
@@ -3,6 +3,7 @@ package billing
 import "fmt"
